title: VDCProfile
description: Configuration schema for Arthur Virtual DSP Cores profiles

profile_name.description: Name of the VDC DSP Profile

cores_allocated.description: CPU cores range isolated for this profile

slots.description: Virtual rack slots representing pre-loaded background plugins

channel_name.description: Name representing this channel insert (e.g., Vocals, Kick)

vst3_dll_path.description: Windows file path to the VST3 DLL inside the guest VM

active.description: Whether this plugin is enabled and processing in the background
